summary: Separate equipment models from physical units
description: Make the inventory work when we buy another camera of the same model.
comments: [{"author": "Nadia Marin", "created": "2026-03-20T15:00:00Z", "body": "Delivered a model page with separate UUID-backed physical units. Model names can repeat; asset tags remain university-wide unique. Acceptance checked two cameras with the same display name and different tags."}]

summary: Default the inventory screen to active units
description: Show Active units by default. Staff can explicitly include Retired units; keep lab and category filters combined with the lifecycle filter.
comments: [{"author": "Nadia Marin", "created": "2026-08-02T15:00:00Z", "body": "The Active filter is applied on first load. Staff can include Retired records without losing the selected lab and category filters."}]

summary: Reject a booking whose end precedes its start
description: Some odd date selections are getting through the booking screen. Make them sensible.
comments: [{"author": "Vlad Petrescu", "created": "2026-03-21T15:00:00Z", "body": "The server now validates endAt later than startAt before conflict checking. The UI retains invalid values for correction instead of creating a reservation."}]

summary: Use the lab time zone on booking details
description: Persist reservation instants in UTC and render booking details using the owning lab IANA time zone. Verify the same UTC instant in Bucharest and London.
comments: [{"author": "Vlad Petrescu", "created": "2026-08-03T15:00:00Z", "body": "Booking details use the owning lab zone; the stored reservation timestamps remain UTC."}]

summary: Explain why a restricted tool cannot be borrowed
description: Students do not understand the training error. Improve it.
comments: [{"author": "Sara Pavel", "created": "2026-03-22T15:00:00Z", "body": "The eligibility panel identifies the missing training category and directs the borrower to a training officer. It does not claim the lab manager can issue the certificate."}]

summary: Keep suspension checks alongside certificate checks
description: A valid training certificate must not permit a suspended borrower to reserve or collect equipment. Test the valid-certificate plus suspended-account combination.
comments: [{"author": "Sara Pavel", "created": "2026-08-04T15:00:00Z", "body": "Suspension blocks both actions even when a matching training certificate is current."}]

summary: Retain the manager decision in history
description: We need to know who decided a request after it leaves the inbox.
comments: [{"author": "Luca Dima", "created": "2026-03-23T15:00:00Z", "body": "Approval and rejection now append actor and request-version audit events. Reviewing a decided request shows the decision maker."}]

summary: Release a rejected approval hold
description: When a manager rejects an AwaitingApproval request with a reason, transition to Rejected and release its interval in the same transaction.
comments: [{"author": "Luca Dima", "created": "2026-08-05T15:00:00Z", "body": "The rejected request retains its reason. Its slot becomes available atomically with the state transition."}]

summary: Keep personal data out of printed equipment QR labels
description: Make the QR stickers safe to put on public equipment shelves.
comments: [{"author": "Ana Stoica", "created": "2026-03-24T15:00:00Z", "body": "Labels encode only the opaque asset UUID. They contain no borrower ID, reservation secret, or authorization token."}]

summary: Record pre-existing accessory exceptions at pickup
description: Staff must confirm required accessories before handover or record an existing exception. Show the checklist beside the borrower and asset tag.
comments: [{"author": "Ana Stoica", "created": "2026-08-06T15:00:00Z", "body": "The pickup checklist records present accessories and pre-existing exceptions as part of handover."}]

summary: Separate physical receipt from condition inspection
description: The return desk needs to scan things in quickly and inspect them afterwards.
comments: [{"author": "Elena Varga", "created": "2026-03-25T15:00:00Z", "body": "Receipt records server receivedAt and puts the loan in ReturnedPendingInspection. A later condition inspection is a separate action; the unit remains unavailable in between."}]

summary: Record a missing accessory during inspection
description: For each required accessory, require present or missing. Missing must open a linked incident and cannot produce a clean inspection result.
comments: [{"author": "Elena Varga", "created": "2026-08-07T15:00:00Z", "body": "Incomplete checklists are rejected and missing accessories route to an incident linked to the loan."}]

summary: Explain extension failures without identifying another student
description: The extension error leaks the next borrower. Clean it up.
comments: [{"author": "Matei Ionescu", "created": "2026-08-07T15:00:00Z", "body": "The borrower sees the extension conflict reason without another borrower's identity. A rejected extension preserves dueAt."}]

summary: Track the ordinary extension count on each loan
description: Only one approved ordinary extension is allowed per loan. A different loan must not inherit the old loan's extension counter.
comments: [{"author": "Matei Ionescu", "created": "2026-08-08T15:00:00Z", "body": "Extension count is stored per loan; the ordinary action rejects a second approved extension on that loan."}]

summary: Retain cancelled reservation history
description: Cancelled bookings should not just disappear from our records.
comments: [{"author": "Iris Popa", "created": "2026-08-08T15:00:00Z", "body": "Cancellation keeps the reservation row, cancellation actor, time, and reason. Cancelled intervals no longer block availability."}]

summary: Send the staff cancellation reason to the borrower inbox
description: A manager cancellation requires a borrower-visible reason. Include the same reason in the in-app notification after commitment.
comments: [{"author": "Iris Popa", "created": "2026-08-09T15:00:00Z", "body": "The borrower receives the recorded manager cancellation reason through the transaction notification."}]

summary: Stop duplicate waiting-list entries
description: People can join the same waiting list several times. Prevent that.
comments: [{"author": "Nadia Marin", "created": "2026-08-09T15:00:00Z", "body": "A borrower can keep one active entry for the same model, lab, and requested interval. The API returns WAITLIST_DUPLICATE for the duplicate tuple."}]

summary: Reserve an offered unit until offer resolution
description: An active waiting-list offer should temporarily block its assigned unit. Acceptance and expiry must use mutually exclusive transitions.
comments: [{"author": "Nadia Marin", "created": "2026-08-10T15:00:00Z", "body": "The offer owns a temporary availability hold. Only one of acceptance or expiry can commit."}]

summary: Expose the pickup deadline on reservation details
description: Students need to see when their pickup hold ends.
comments: [{"author": "Vlad Petrescu", "created": "2026-08-10T15:00:00Z", "body": "Reservation details include pickupDeadlineAt in UTC and render the start and deadline in the owning lab time zone. This task did not choose or change the grace-period duration."}]

summary: Separate worker run time from scheduled pickup deadline
description: When expiry runs late, retain the scheduled deadline and record actual processing time separately. Do not move the displayed deadline to worker execution time.
comments: [{"author": "Vlad Petrescu", "created": "2026-08-11T15:00:00Z", "body": "The expiry event and reservation deadline remain distinct, making delayed worker runs visible without altering the schedule."}]

summary: Compute overdue hours from loan timestamps
description: The overdue counter drifts when the worker misses a run. Make it reliable.
comments: [{"author": "Sara Pavel", "created": "2026-08-11T15:00:00Z", "body": "Overdue duration is derived from dueAt and receipt or current server time rather than accumulated worker increments."}]

summary: Separate automatic and manual restriction reasons
description: Return distinct machine reasons for overdue_loan and manual_suspension. Do not represent all restrictions as one permanent account boolean.
comments: [{"author": "Sara Pavel", "created": "2026-08-12T15:00:00Z", "body": "The restriction service exposes separate reasons and derives overdue restriction state from current loans."}]

summary: Link incident reports to the affected borrowing record
description: We cannot tell which loan a damage note belongs to. Fix incident traceability.
comments: [{"author": "Luca Dima", "created": "2026-08-12T15:00:00Z", "body": "New incident reports require asset, loan, reporting actor, observation time, type, and observation text."}]

summary: Guard private incident photograph downloads
description: Check incident_reader for the incident's owning lab on every photo request. Return private authorized links only after this check.
comments: [{"author": "Luca Dima", "created": "2026-08-13T15:00:00Z", "body": "Private photograph access requires a matching incident_reader grant rather than general borrower or audit access."}]

summary: Show repair progress while a supplier has the unit
description: A repair should not look completed just because we shipped it to a supplier.
comments: [{"author": "Ana Stoica", "created": "2026-08-13T15:00:00Z", "body": "Supplier repairs remain InProgress until staff record the service outcome. The maintenance block stays in force."}]

summary: Record technician and service outcome at completion
description: Service completion must record the required checklist, outcome, and technician attestation, with server completedAt.
comments: [{"author": "Ana Stoica", "created": "2026-08-14T15:00:00Z", "body": "The completed job includes the checklist results, outcome, attesting technician, and authoritative completion instant."}]

summary: Keep transfer custody separate from student borrowing
description: Moving an asset on the university van should not create an overdue student loan.
comments: [{"author": "Elena Varga", "created": "2026-08-14T15:00:00Z", "body": "Transfers have separate custody events and do not create a borrower loan or overdue borrower record."}]

summary: Prevent dispatching equipment still on loan
description: Reject transfer dispatch if the asset has an Open loan. Return ASSET_ON_LOAN without recording dispatch.
comments: [{"author": "Elena Varga", "created": "2026-08-15T15:00:00Z", "body": "Dispatch checks outstanding borrowing and returns 409 ASSET_ON_LOAN without changing custody."}]

summary: Keep physical unit identities inside kits
description: Bundle the field recorder equipment without losing track of the individual serialled units.
comments: [{"author": "Matei Ionescu", "created": "2026-08-15T15:00:00Z", "body": "The kit definition references component asset UUIDs. Kit membership neither merges identities nor replaces physical unit records."}]

summary: Require scans for each tracked kit component
description: Checkout must scan every required tracked component and reject a missing or wrong unit with KIT_SCAN_INCOMPLETE.
comments: [{"author": "Matei Ionescu", "created": "2026-08-16T15:00:00Z", "body": "The kit handover screen validates each tracked component scan before checkout can commit."}]

summary: Deduplicate notification intents after worker retries
description: Worker redelivery sends multiple copies of one change. Make notification creation safe.
comments: [{"author": "Iris Popa", "created": "2026-08-16T15:00:00Z", "body": "Intent uniqueness uses domain event ID, recipient ID, and channel. Redelivering one outbox event does not create a second identical intent."}]

summary: Do not accept offers when their messages are read
description: Marking a waiting-list notification read must not create a reservation. Only the explicit offer acceptance action may do so.
comments: [{"author": "Iris Popa", "created": "2026-08-17T15:00:00Z", "body": "Read receipts change inbox state only and never perform offer acceptance."}]

summary: Keep selected lab separate from permission grants
description: Changing the header lab should not let students open staff screens.
comments: [{"author": "Nadia Marin", "created": "2026-08-17T15:00:00Z", "body": "The lab selector changes interface context only. All protected data still requires server authorization from stored grants."}]

summary: Ignore actor IDs supplied by API clients
description: Derive mutation actorId exclusively from the authenticated session. A request body field cannot impersonate a different staff member.
comments: [{"author": "Nadia Marin", "created": "2026-08-18T15:00:00Z", "body": "Mutation audit attribution uses the session actor even when a malicious request supplies another actorId."}]

summary: Make sensitive-action history append only
description: An edited record needs to leave its previous history intact.
comments: [{"author": "Vlad Petrescu", "created": "2026-08-18T15:00:00Z", "body": "Corrections generate new audit events. No API can rewrite an existing event body, and writer permissions enforce append-only storage."}]

summary: Summarize audit cleanup without duplicating deleted records
description: Each retention run should retain aggregate deletion counts but must not copy deleted event bodies into its own run log.
comments: [{"author": "Vlad Petrescu", "created": "2026-08-19T15:00:00Z", "body": "Operational summaries contain aggregate counts only; the cleanup job does not create a second copy of removed events."}]

summary: Publish integration events only after commitment
description: The scheduler sometimes sees a booking event for a booking that never committed. Fix publication ordering.
comments: [{"author": "Sara Pavel", "created": "2026-08-19T15:00:00Z", "body": "Integration events come from the transactional outbox after their domain transaction commits."}]

summary: Stop revoked service credentials immediately
description: A revoked service credential must fail subsequent API requests without an application restart. Verify another active credential remains usable.
comments: [{"author": "Sara Pavel", "created": "2026-08-20T15:00:00Z", "body": "Credential revocation affects the next request; it does not depend on worker or API process restarts."}]

summary: Show report provenance in the footer
description: Managers cannot tell what period a downloaded report covers. Include its context.
comments: [{"author": "Luca Dima", "created": "2026-08-20T15:00:00Z", "body": "The footer shows lab, local date range, generatedAt, and row-limit status. The job stores normalized UTC bounds and input time zone."}]

summary: Recheck access before an export download
description: A completed export can be downloaded only by its original requester while they still hold manager grants for the exported labs.
comments: [{"author": "Luca Dima", "created": "2026-08-21T15:00:00Z", "body": "Download checks both requester identity and current grants; revoking access blocks a previously generated result."}]
